title: DynBox OTA Release Manifest
description: Versioned manifest describing an over-the-air configuration release for a DynBox Flutter application.

appId.description: Unique identifier of the application (e.g. com.example.myapp).

releaseId.description: Unique identifier for this release deployment.

platform.description: Target OS platform or 'all' for cross-platform configurations.

minAppVersion.description: Minimum binary app version required to apply this configuration.

payloadUrl.description: Remote HTTPS URL to fetch the configuration payload from.

payloadJson.description: Embedded configuration payload string (for direct or mock distributions).

payloadSha256.description: Cryptographic SHA-256 digest of the configuration payload.

payloadSizeBytes.description: Size in bytes of the configuration payload (maximum 512 KB).

publishedAt.description: Timestamp when this release manifest was published.

expiresAt.description: Optional expiration timestamp after which the release is considered obsolete.

keyId.description: Identifier of the public signing key used to sign the manifest.
